title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Rebuild a mosque with basement parking. 1961 views Q. AssalamAlaikum Respected Mufti Saab, Since the construction of our masjid ten years ago, the qibla was assumed to be exactly eastwards i.e 90 degrees clockwise. (using a standard 360 degree rotation) Using more accurate and reliable calculations, we have calculated the qibla again and it is in fact 66.52 degrees clockwise. It means therefore that our present qibla direction is off by approximately 23.48 degrees to the actual qibla. Is this amount of variation allowed? What should we do henceforth? An urgant reply will be most appreciated as this issue is of utmost importance to our entire community. JazakAllah. 3078 views Q. masjid Shop 2449 views Q. Can we build mosque/madrasa on the common plot of the society without getting consent of all concerned parties of plots of particular area? 6371 views Q. Sunnat of entering in Masjid 2615 views Q. My question is a trust registered with charity commissioner as Powai Educational Trust took land on lease from landlord in Chawl and made an agreement with landlord saying they will use this as madrasa and will not built or use it as mosque 1641 views Q. ASSALAAMU A'LAIKUM,HAJRAT,after my fathers death, i got a piece of land on which,a portion of land I have made WAQF for MASJID. But there are more 2 MOSJIDS nearly that area. So, the villagers are not allowing for ONE MORE MOSJID. Then, what can i do with that portion of land? JAZAA KUMULLAAHU KHAIRAN. 1698 views Q. Our Masjid has 3 floors not 2 2632 views Q. Are we Muslims allowed to sleep in a mosque? 12286 views Q. Interior decoration for Masjid (POP work) is it allowed? if allowed to whatextent? Masjid located in South India. 2416 views Q. About charity given to masjids 5856 views Q. Construting Mosque ove septic tank 1782 views Q. Could you please let me know if it is permissible to have shops on rent basis in the masjid building (in the entrance area or in any part of the masjid) and also if that amount (rent) could be used for covering the expenses of the Masjid 2225 views Q. my uncle have purchased a land which was encroached illegally by others beside a mosque. My uncle knew that the land is encroached. now he wants to give that land to masjid , is it permissible to give that land to construct the masjid. 2249 views Q. In my village, there is a Eidgaah where we perform both Eid and Baqr-Eid Prayers. But the large number of people cannot perform in it because it is too small. And also there is no room at both the sides so that it can be extended. So we want to know that can this Eidgaah be sold and another land can be bought. Or can it be exchanged with another land? Please reply soon. It is an urgent Mas?alah. 2960 views

Question: Kya kahte hain Ulma-e-Kiram is baare mein --- 1. Kya Masjid me 'Waaz' ka intizaam kiya ja sakta hai ? 2.Agar Masjid mein 'Waaz' ka intizaam kiya ja sakta hai, to kya wahan 'Ladies' ko bhi sunne ke liye daawat di jaa sakti hai jabki parde ka pura intizaam ho? Answer ID: 7490 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 893/893=M/1429) A sermon can be arranged in mosque provided the mosque is not desecrated and norms of mosques are not violated. (2) The state of their purity and impurity is not known, also it is an age of mischief and evil, therefore the women should not be invited to mosques. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
